clue.text: Music-maker identifying English reservoir

definitions.meaning: an instrument, here the triple-strung harp of Wales
the popular name of the Brent Reservoir in north-west London

explanation.walkthrough: 'identifying' simply links the two senses: the instrument and the London reservoir share the name.
explanation.definitionFit: The triple harp traditional in Wales is an instrument, and a reservoir in Brent, London, carries the same nickname.

clue.text: Plump for this angle in a race

indicators.note: the words a race are set inside the word for angle, which wraps around them

parts.note: to angle is to fish
the TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Advice on choosing a fishing angle during a race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'angle' is a verb here, FISH, and A TT goes into it: F(A TT)ISH. The TT is the famous Isle of Man motorbike race.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhat fat, as a plump person is.

clue.text: Snatched away as child slept

parts.note: a kid is a child
napped means had a short sleep

explanation.surface: A child is spirited off while asleep.
explanation.definitionFit: Abducted, carried off by force.

clue.text: Infuriate, holding out -improperly — for retainers

indicators.note: the word for infuriate holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: to infuriate is to enrage

indicators.note: the word out is set wrongly, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Making someone furious by keeping retainers outside improperly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'improperly' turns OUT into TOU, which 'holding' puts inside ENRAGE: EN(TOU)RAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A great person's followers or attendants are their retinue.

clue.text: Container for holding a shell

parts.note: the shell is not ammunition but that of a boiled egg, sitting in its little cup at breakfast

explanation.definitionFit: A small cup that holds a boiled egg in its shell.

clue.text: Rule longer route must be adjusted, in case of Gulf

indicators.note: the letters of route are to be adjusted, set in a new order
the little word in forms a case around the next piece

parts.note: G is the standard abbreviation for gulf on maps

explanation.surface: A ruler outlasting another while a route is redrawn for a Gulf state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'must be adjusted' makes OUTRE from ROUTE; then 'case of' has IN enclosing G: I(G)N.
explanation.definitionFit: To reign for longer than another monarch.

clue.text: In a trade arrangement I send things out

indicators.note: the letter I goes into the rearranged letters
a fresh arrangement of the letters of a trade

explanation.surface: Someone in a trade deal is busy dispatching goods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' turns A TRADE into RADATE, and 'In' puts I inside: RAD(I)ATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To emit in all directions, as heat or light from a source.

clue.text: Soldier holds exploded shell in dish

indicators.note: the soldier's letters hold the next piece inside

parts.note: GI is an American soldier

indicators.note: the shell's letters are blown apart and rearranged

parts.note: a conch is a large sea shell

explanation.surface: A soldier hangs on to a shell that has gone off in the food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exploded' turns CONCH into NOCCH, and 'holds' sets it inside GI.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian potato dumplings served as a dish.

clue.text: Wiping out evil clad in fancy gear

indicators.note: the word for evil is dressed in the other letters
the letters of gear are worked into a fancy new order

parts.note: sin is evil-doing

explanation.surface: Removing wickedness by dressing it in fancy clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' makes ERAG from GEAR, and SIN is 'clad in' it: ERA(SIN)G.
explanation.definitionFit: Deleting or rubbing out completely.

clue.text: Accommodation for boss on Greek island

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece placed on another comes before it

parts.note: a stud is an ornamental boss
Ios is an island in the Cyclades

explanation.surface: Housing for a manager on a Greek island holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boss' is not a manager but a raised knob or stud.
explanation.definitionFit: Small one-room flats are a kind of living accommodation.

clue.text: Butchering is an act of the devil

indicators.note: the words is an act are hacked up and reassembled

explanation.surface: Slaughtering animals is called a fiendish thing to do.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to Satan, the devil, or diabolical in character.

clue.text: Enact true reform, it's said

indicators.note: the words enact true are re-formed into a new order

explanation.surface: A call to bring about genuine reform, reportedly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it's said' looks like a homophone signal but is the definition: something spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoken word or statement is something that someone has said.

clue.text: Bird stuffed its crop with three leaflets

parts.note: a tern is a seabird
a bird filling its crop has eaten

explanation.surface: A bird gorged itself on a plant with three-part leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanically, a leaf divided into three leaflets is trifoliate.

clue.text: May be seen playing in the nursery

definitions.text: May be seen playing in the nursery

parts.words: May be seen playing in the nursery
parts.note: the nursery is a plant nursery, and playing means spraying water rather than children at games

explanation.definitionFit: A garden watering tube plays water over plants in a garden centre.

clue.text: The language when, after a leg-break, I get caught!

indicators.note: a leg broken has its letters rearranged

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A cricketer's cry when a leg-break delivery gets them out.
explanation.walkthrough: A leg-break is a spinning delivery in cricket; here 'break' shakes up A LEG into GAEL.
explanation.definitionFit: The Celtic tongue of Ireland or Scotland.

clue.text: Get garage to assemble parts

indicators.note: the letters of get garage are to be put together in a new order

explanation.surface: Having a garage put together a vehicle from components.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parts' is the definition: aggregate is the crushed stone or gravel pieces mixed into concrete.
explanation.definitionFit: In building, aggregate is the broken stone and gravel fragments bound together in concrete.

clue.text: Accusing motoring organisation-it's mad, banning first gear in the race!

indicators.note: the letters are driven mad, scrambled into a new order
one letter is barred from the mixture
the first letter of gear is taken

parts.note: the AA is Britain's Automobile Association

explanation.surface: Blaming a motoring body, which seems insane, for stopping cars in first gear in a race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banning' removes G (the 'first' letter of gear) from ACCUSING, and 'it's mad' scrambles what is left, ACCUSIN, with AA.
explanation.definitionFit: An old ethnological label for the white peoples, named after the Caucasus.

clue.text: Time is pressing

definitions.meaning: the part of the day after afternoon
making level or smooth, as with an iron

explanation.walkthrough: 'pressing' is not urgent but flattening, from even as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Late day is a time; smoothing flat is making something level.

clue.text: Speed-toy Clive's written off

indicators.note: the toy has been wrecked, its letters rearranged with those of Clive

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Clive's speedy toy car has been smashed beyond repair.
explanation.definitionFit: Rate of motion in a given direction.

clue.text: Peeled off, in a ceremonial march

indicators.note: the letters are off, disordered

parts.note: pared means peeled, as fruit

explanation.surface: Stripped bare during a formal procession.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal procession of marchers.

clue.text: Indian given a knock and a call

parts.note: a rap is a sharp knock
ho is a call to attract attention

explanation.surface: Someone knocked on the door and shouted a greeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a Native American people of the Great Plains.

clue.text: Mathematical term worker and I record

parts.note: an ant is the standard worker insect
a log is a record

explanation.surface: An employee and I keep a mathematical record.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for antilogarithm, the number whose logarithm is given.

clue.text: The consequences of holding goods and chattels

explanation.walkthrough: 'of holding' links the two senses: holdings are what one owns.
explanation.definitionFit: Results flow from causes; personal property is also called by the same name.

clue.text: Huge fire, it swirls round reactor core-right inside

indicators.note: the letter for right goes inside the anagram
the letters of fire it swirl round into a new order
the core of reactor is its middle letter

explanation.surface: A great blaze whirls about a nuclear reactor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swirls round' turns FIRE IT into TERIFI, with R put 'inside' it, then C, the 'core' of reactor.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, enormous or tremendous.

clue.text: I'd plunged into a river, surfacing with something we can have for dinner

definitions.text: something we can have for dinner

indicators.note: in a down clue coming up to the surface means read upwards
I'd dives into the river's letters

parts.note: the Elbe is a German river

explanation.surface: Diving into a river and coming up holding food.
explanation.walkthrough: ID goes into ELBE to make ELBIDE, and 'surfacing' reads it upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Fit to be eaten.

clue.text: Warned about education

indicators.note: the word education is turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: Told off on the subject of schooling.
explanation.definitionFit: Given a warning, admonished.

clue.text: Painter at first sight is certainly not way out

parts.note: Ingres was a French neoclassical painter

indicators.note: only the first letter of sight is taken

explanation.surface: An artist's work at first glance is hardly avant-garde.
explanation.walkthrough: 'way out' tempts as slang for eccentric; the definition is literal: an entry, the opposite of an exit.
explanation.definitionFit: An entrance or means of going in, opposite of an exit.

clue.text: Label on cover, but there's nothing inside the newspaper

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece placed on another comes before it

parts.note: a tab is a label

indicators.note: the zero goes inside the cover word

parts.note: a lid is a cover
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A label stuck on the front, but the newspaper is empty.
explanation.definitionFit: A small-format popular paper.

clue.text: Name of little bird I follow in the meadow

indicators.note: the bird and I go inside the meadow

parts.note: a lea is a meadow

indicators.note: I follows the bird, coming after it

parts.note: a tit is a small bird

explanation.surface: A tiny bird's name, tracked in a field.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, a form of Laetitia.

clue.text: Therefore, no good to go on wheels taking the air, linked with others

parts.note: so means therefore
to cycle is to ride a bicycle

explanation.surface: So it's no use cycling out for some fresh air with others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking the air' tempts as a stroll; the air is a tune, linked into a series.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of songs composed to be performed as one sequence.
